intro.h2: Kitchen Remodeling in Roseville, with the Numbers Up Front
paragraphs: Most people asking about kitchen remodeling in Roseville want two things before anyone swings a hammer: a real price and a real schedule. Anani Remodeling gives you both. After an in-home visit, you get a written quote that lists materials, trades and phases line by line, and if anything changes mid-project, you hear about it before the crew acts.

The office is on Lava Ridge Court, so site visits, sample reviews and inspection days are run by people who work locally, not a franchise crew sent from hours away. Some clients gut the whole room. Others only need the layout fixed or the cabinets swapped. Both get the same care, and Natalie K. noted the crew showed up on time every day.

services.h2: Kitchens, Baths and Cabinets Built to Fit

items.name: Kitchen Remodeling
items.blurb: Full remodels that rethink layout, plumbing, electrical, cabinets, counters and lighting, or targeted upgrades like new counters, refacing and better light. If a wall needs to come out, the team checks what is structural, brings in an engineer when needed and prices the change.

image.alt: White kitchen remodel with waterfall quartz island, woven counter stools, open oak shelves and a plaster range hood

items.name: Bathroom Remodeling
items.blurb: Guest bath refreshes and full primary suite overhauls: walk-in shower conversions, frameless glass, custom tile, new vanities, heated floors and freestanding tubs. Every bath starts with a real in-home consultation, not a ballpark over the phone, and permits are handled for you.

image.alt: Remodeled bathroom with frameless glass walk-in shower, large light stone tile and a warm wood vanity with black pulls

items.name: Custom Cabinetry
items.blurb: Cabinets built to the exact size of your room, with no filler strips or wasted corners. Choose the wood, finish and hardware, with dovetail joinery and soft-close drawers. The same crew that builds them installs them, for kitchens, vanities, closets, offices and built-ins.

image.alt: Custom walnut kitchen island with fluted panels and turned legs beside sage green perimeter cabinets and an arched open shelf niche

why_choose_us.h2: What Homeowners Get from Anani Remodeling

items.title: Planning prices in public
items.text: The site lists typical ranges for the Roseville and Sacramento market, from $25,000 for a cosmetic refresh to $100,000 and up for a high-end renovation. Your own number comes in writing after a visit.

items.title: One crew from shop to install
items.text: Custom cabinets are made to order and installed by the same crew that built them. No outsourcing and no dropped details between the shop and your kitchen.

items.title: Permits planned by city
items.text: Roseville, Rocklin, Folsom and Sacramento each run their own building review, while Granite Bay, Fair Oaks and El Dorado Hills go through the county. The team plans the schedule around the office that covers your address.

items.title: Finished ahead of schedule
items.text: Reviewers mention upfront pricing with no hidden costs, a crew that arrived on time daily, and the easiest estimate process of all the companies one homeowner called.

about.h2: Founded by Daniel Malinovskiy, Run from Roseville
about.text: Daniel Malinovskiy founded Anani Remodeling as a Sacramento-area contractor, not a franchise. The company focuses on kitchen remodeling, bathroom remodeling and custom cabinetry, and manages each job from design through construction. Homeowners work directly with the principals rather than a salesperson or call center, and one point of contact stays with the project from the first call to the final walkthrough. The team counts more than 150 delivered projects and over 10 years of combined experience. Most new clients come from a neighbor's recommendation, and the company is licensed, bonded and insured under CSLB #1157715.

steps.title: Consultation
steps.text: An in-home visit to see the space, assess structure and talk through what you want to change, why, and what budget fits.

steps.title: Design Plan

steps.title: The Build
steps.text: The crew works to an agreed schedule, keeps the site safe, and cleans up every day before leaving your home.

steps.title: The Finish
steps.text: A 50-point quality walkthrough and your sign-off before the new kitchen or bath is handed over to you.

service_area.h2: Placer, Sacramento and El Dorado County Towns We Serve
service_area.text: The team works out of Roseville and takes kitchens and baths across Rocklin, Granite Bay, Folsom, El Dorado Hills, Fair Oaks and Sacramento. That covers newer planned-community homes with builder-grade kitchens as well as older Land Park and East Sacramento bungalows where wiring and drain lines need a closer look. Kitchen projects are also taken in Elk Grove, Citrus Heights and Rancho Cordova. Not sure about your street? Call and they will confirm.

faq.h2: Kitchen and Bath Questions from Roseville Homeowners

items.q: How much does a kitchen remodel cost in Roseville?
items.a: Anani publishes planning ranges for the Roseville and Sacramento market: about $25,000 to $45,000 for a cosmetic refresh, $50,000 to $90,000 for a mid-range full remodel, and $100,000 and up for a high-end renovation. These are starting points only. Your price comes in writing, line by line, after the team sees your kitchen.

items.q: How long will my kitchen be out of service?
items.a: From first meeting to cooking again, a full remodel often takes about three to five months, because design, permits and cabinet orders come first. The kitchen itself is usually out of use for four to eight weeks. The team flags the most disruptive days ahead of time so you can set up a temporary station.

items.q: Do you pull permits in Roseville and the other towns?
items.a: Yes. The team prepares permit applications, submits plans and schedules inspections on every project that needs them. Roseville, Rocklin, Folsom and Sacramento use their own city building offices, while Granite Bay, Fair Oaks and El Dorado Hills go through their counties, so the schedule is planned around your office.

Yes. Financing options are available through Foundation Finance, subject to lender approval and terms. You can also phase a project if you would rather spread the work out. Ask about both during your free in-home estimate so your written quote can reflect the plan that fits your budget.

items.q: Is the work covered by a warranty?
items.a: The site describes a 1-Year Artisan Warranty: completed work is backed by a warranty covering labor and installation, plus the manufacturer warranties on materials. Ask for the written warranty terms with your quote so you know exactly what is covered on your kitchen or bathroom project.

final_cta.text: Book a free in-home estimate and get a written, line-by-line quote before any work begins.
